traceability_notes: The Stage 1 handoff contains hypothesis, method, experiment plan, baseline expectation, and Risk Factors and Limitations.
The current eight real-reuse tasks are development-only and cannot support held-out EffectSlice claims.

Ordinary-device execution is API-first: a local PC performs orchestration, bounded tool execution, artifact persistence, deterministic scoring, and verification while trusted vendor APIs provide model inference.

DeepSeek V3.2 is the primary user-approved inference service through request alias deepseek-v4-flash; GPT gpt-5.6 is robustness-only. No local accelerator or local quantized model is required for core evidence.
